Hi, this is Daniel from Coastline Travel, calling about your December itinerary. Good news first: your flight is confirmed, and you are going to land in Los Angeles at six in the evening on the third. The car is ready too. Now the bad news: it is peak season, and two of the motels on your route are already sold out. I will look for other options tonight, and I will send you a new list tomorrow morning. One piece of advice: do not leave anything for the last minute. Prices are going to go up after the first of November. Call me back when you can.

Good morning, and here is your travel outlook for December. This year, airports will be busier than ever, so if you are going to fly, arrive at least three hours early. Look at the sky over the Midwest right now: those heavy clouds mean it is going to snow tonight, and some flights will probably be delayed tomorrow. On the coast, the weather will stay dry and mild, which is great news for anyone on a road trip. My advice? Keep your budget flexible and your itinerary simple.

After that, he writes the itinerary and books ahead, because it is peak season. Next, one hotel is sold out, so he decides he will stay somewhere else. Finally, on the fourth, he sets off from Los Angeles and drives up the coast.
